metadata.title: Repository-Local Decision Context for Software Agents: Public Study Artifacts
metadata.description: Public, de-identified artifacts for an exploratory empirical study of repository-local decision context and bounded reviewer interaction for software agents. The release will include public task cards, evaluator specifications, protocol and deviation records, aggregate and public-run results, analysis code, and reproduction instructions. Seven outcomes from an earlier invalid specification are quarantined and excluded. Internal repositories, tasks, identifiers, prompts, patches, traces, employee data, and restricted implementation details are not included.
